Placeholder, tracked in [#58](https://github.com/UBC-DSCI/reproducible-and-trustworthy-workflows-for-data-science/issues/58).

Continuous deployment of a Python package built with uv:
building with `uv build`, publishing to TestPyPI and PyPI with `uv publish`,
and bumping versions with Python Semantic Release run through `uvx`.
The `pycounts` demo's workflow is the starting point.
The Poetry version is in the Archive as
[Continuous deployment: Python (Poetry)](9550-continuous-deployment-python-poetry.qmd).
